title: Studio: "New similar" on a flow over the clone door — the copy lands inactive in <base>.custom or the open writable package; Setup's clone link follows it
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P2, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P2 "N-22 Studio 'new similar' on a flow"; Q6 「全部同意」 (clone kept only as "new similar" into `.custom`). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28149

Part of #28236 (P2, child **N-22**) · governs: ADR-0146 D4 (clone survives only as "new similar"), Q6, ADR-0126 §7.1 (a new machine name is mandatory) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: S.

**Business reason.** An admin wants a second flow like one of HotCRM's, for another rule, without changing HotCRM's. Today the only copy is Setup's clone, and the copy belongs to no package. With this card Studio offers "New similar" on the flow. The copy lands in `hotcrm.custom`, off until the admin turns it on.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- Studio offers no copy of a flow. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx` has Delete only, drawn for a writable package (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx:9725`).
- `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone` takes a new name only. `setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` is its only caller. Its result link "Open the clone in Studio" goes to the package-less scope (`studioOrgScopePath`, :573–578).
- N-21 (#28149, waiting on N-13) changes the door:
  - a given target must be writable, with the flow's objects in its closure;
  - an omitted target means the source's `<base>.custom`, ensured;
  - the copy is written inactive, and the response says so.
  The response's exact shape is not settled yet.

**Wanted.**
1. "New similar" in the flow's menu, on a read-only package's flow and on a writable package's flow. It asks for a new machine name (mandatory) and a label.
2. On a read-only base, no target is sent and the door picks the pair. On a writable package, the target is the open package.
3. The server's sentence that the copy is inactive is shown verbatim. A `409` (name taken) and every other refusal are shown verbatim.
4. On success Studio opens the copy where it lives: the pair, or the base's surface once N-19 folds the pair.
5. Setup's "Open the clone in Studio" opens the copy's package, read from the clone response, not the package-less scope — a rider asks #28149 to carry this one line in its own PR; this card checks it and re-points the link only if that PR did not.
6. No lineage is drawn: no "based on" and no link back (ADR-0126 §9, second bullet).

**Tests.** On a read-only base, the request carries no target and the copy opens in the pair. On a writable package, the target is the open package. The inactive sentence is shown as sent. A `409` is shown verbatim and the dialog stays open. Setup's result link carries the copy's package. Each item has an ablation.

**Release safety.** Safe on its own with N-21 merged (Blocked-by #28149). Between N-21 and this card, Setup's result link would point at the package-less scope, where the copy no longer is; the rider on #28149 closes that in N-21's own PR, and item 5 is the check.

**Not here.** The door (N-21). Overriding a flow under its own name (N-18). Permission-set "new similar" (N-20b). Retiring Setup › Packaged automation (N-28).

**Dedupe.** objectui#13270 (the clone result's offers, Setup side). Searched `new similar flow studio`: only #28149 and the epic.

Links back: #28236, #28149, ADR-0146 D4, ADR-0126 §7.1, §9.
